title: Polycyclic polyprenylated acylphloroglucinols from the fruit of Hypericum addingtonii N. Robson and their α-glucosidase inhibitory activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47452-47463
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05247E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qian Feng, Rui-Dan Hu, Xian-Feng Xiao, Aijia Ji, Li-Jun Qiao
This paper presents the first chemical investigation of the fruit of Hypericum addingtonii N. Robson, leading to the isolation of seven previously undescribed compounds and 14 known polycyclic polyprenylated acylphloroglucinols.
